The reported NAV is ex-dividend a special dividend of 0.75 pence per Ordinary share which will be paid on 30 September 2026 to those shareholders on the Company’s register on 21 August 2026. The unaudited cum-dividend NAV was 32.72 pence per Ordinary share. As at 31 August 2026, there were 360,482 2021 realisation shares in issue. As at 31 August 2026 the closing mid share price of a 2021 realisation share in the Company was £1.00000 and represented a discount of 66.45% to the NAV per 2021 realisation share.
